pages.text: A full EU-based tech tree from LV to UHV, with pipes, cables, and multiblock machines. This is the pack's main endgame tech mod.

$(bold)Note:$() Steel in this pack is unified - $(bold)MI steel is the only real steel$(). Stellaris steel ore now generates normally - smelt it into a Stellaris steel ingot as usual, then convert that 1:1 into MI steel with a simple crafting recipe (same for nuggets).
